Bip Max

Max Out Every Moment

Regular price Sale price $99.99

Bip Max is built for people who want one watch that can keep up with everything they try. From gym sessions and group classes, to first runs and recovery days, it supports hybrid training in a simple, intuitive way.
A bigger, brighter display keeps your stats front and center. A battery that goes for up to 20 days means you don’t have to stop to recharge. More storage gives you space for every workout, podcast, and whatever comes next. More screen. More power. More possibility.
  • Vibrant 2.07" AMOLED display for easy-to-read data under any light
  • Up to 20 days of battery life for maximized endurance
  • 4GB storage for maps and up to 100 hours of podcasts
  • Advanced health metrics with BioCharge energy monitoring
  • Train your way with advanced Hybrid Training tools

Bigger Display. Max Visibility.

The large 2.07" AMOLED display keeps your data front and center, with enhanced brightness for clear visibility in any lighting. Crafted with a lightweight aluminum alloy body and a clean two-button design, Bip Max delivers a sleek, modern feel that moves effortlessly from daily wear to training.

Bigger Battery. Max Endurance.

Say goodbye to nightly charges. The Bip Max can last up to 20 days¹ with typical usage, delivering long-lasting performance that keeps up with your routine and tracks your health and fitness data for longer.

Max Space. More to Explore.

With up to 4GB of onboard storage available, you can keep your favorite podcasts² and offline maps³ stored on the watch for easy, quick access right from your wrist.

Move with Max Clarity.

Detailed maps are free to download from the Zepp App, with turn-by-turn directions guiding you to your destination, and alerts for when you stray off-track. The large display keeps every twist and turn easily visible, while fast, accurate GPS tracking - backed up by five satellite navigation systems⁴ - keeps your route precise.

Zepp App, Powering Amazfit.

Hybrid Training is a structured training approach that combines endurance, strength, and recovery into a balanced system designed to improve long-term performance. Within the Zepp App, this philosophy is supported through delivering an all-in-one hub for training, nutrition, and recovery. Get personalized insights, set goals, and see your progress over time — all subscription-free.

Move More, Track More.

​Built-In Workouts.

Bip Max includes a Training Library with built-in workouts you can start anytime. From base training to aerobic foundation training, each workout is designed to help you build rhythm, structure, and consistency into your routine.

Connect Your Training.

Import structured training plans from TrainingPeaks, Runna, and Intervals.icu automatically sync completed activities with Strava so your workouts and progress stay connected across the tools you use.

Manage Your Gear.

Track mileage and usage for running shoes, cycling gear, and other equipment alongside your training history. Manage wear more evenly and know when it’s time to rotate, replace, or tune up.

BioCharge™ Monitoring.

From the moment you wake up after a night of rest, your BioCharge™ score will adapt based on your daily workouts, activities, and stress levels.

  • Personalized Training Plans

    Zepp Coach™ generates personalized workout plans that adapt to your performance and recovery. Choose from versatile training programs or specific running plans.

  • 150+ Sports Modes

    Find dedicated workout modes for hybrid training, HYROX, strength training, yoga, pilates, and much more.

  • Smarter Metrics

    Track key performance metrics like VO₂ Max⁵, Training Stress Balance, Training Load, and Training Effect to optimize your training and make every workout count.

  • 24/7 Health Monitoring

    24/7 Health MonitoringBioTracker™ technology tracks heart rate during workouts to help you understand effort and intensity in real time, while sleep⁶, HRV, blood oxygen, and stress insights help balance training and recovery.

  • RestoreIQ™

    Our sleep tracking algorithm helps you stay on top of your recovery with detailed insights into your heart rate variability, sleep quality, breathing patterns, sleep stages, and even naps.

  • One-Tap Measuring

    Test your heart rate, stress level, blood-oxygen, and breathing rate simultaneously for a quick overview of all four metrics in only 45 seconds.

  • Runna

  • TrainingPeaks

  • Strava

Max Control. Just Ask.

Along with 6-level font size adjustment making your key info easy to read, you can also control your watch with your voice⁷ using Zepp Flow™; adjust settings, view your BioCharge score, send WhatsApp message replies⁸, record voice memos, and more.

What's in the Box.

At Amazfit, we try to do our part to give you the tech you need to achieve your goals, while making sure it's done in a sustainable way.

That's why your Bip Max will come packaged⁹ in 100% recyclable materials, with a charging base (USB Type-C compatible) in the box - but no cable, to reduce waste on our side and extra cords at home on your side.

Bip Max Dimensions

Frequently Asked Questions

Who is Bip Max built for?

Active people who want one watch that keeps up with everything they try. From lifting and running to group fitness classes and everyday activity, Bip Max tracks workouts, monitors health, and supports progress without complicated setup.

How long does the Amazfit Bip Max smartwatch battery last?

Up to 20 days with typical usage, up to 10 days with heavy use, and up to 40 hours of continuous GPS.

What health metrics does Bip Max track?

Bip Max tracks heart rate, blood oxygen, HRV, stress, and sleep continuously throughout the day. BioCharge™ energy monitoring adapts based on workouts, activity, stress, and recovery, helping you better understand your energy and readiness over time.

Does Bip Max support training plans?

Yes. Zepp Coach™ builds personalized training plans, while the built in Training Library supports structured workouts across strength, endurance, and recovery. Bip Max also syncs with TrainingPeaks, Runna, and Strava to help keep your training connected.

Is the Amazfit Bip Max smartwatch waterproof? If so, how deep can it go?

Bip Max features a water-resistance grade of 5 ATM, meaning it can withstand pressure equivalent to 50 meters or 164 feet of static water depth for up to 10 minutes.

Can I use Amazfit Bip Max without my phone?

Yes. Built in GPS and 4GB of onboard storage for offline maps make it easy to train, navigate, and stay connected without carrying your phone.

Does the Bip Max smartwatch work with Apple iPhone and Android mobile phones or devices?

Yes, Amazfit Bip Max is compatible with both Apple iOS and Samsung, Google or other Android OS based mobile phones.

Why doesn't the Amazfit Bip Max smartwatch package include a USB-C cable?

Amazfit is committed to sustainability, striving to minimize environmental impact and promote waste reduction across its products and operations. Many users already have an extra unused USB-C cable. If you do not have one, please reach out to our Customer Support at support.na@amazfit.com.

Notes

1. The battery life may vary according to the settings, operation conditions and other factors. So the actual result may differ from the laboratory data.
Typical usage scenario: Static watch face; 24-hour wear / Heart rate constantly on (every 5 mins) / Sleep monitoring (Assisted sleep monitoring enabled). Bluetooth calling: 15 mins/week. Music playback via Bluetooth headphones: 30 mins/week. 3 workouts per week, 30 minutes each with watch-side GPS running. Raise-to-wake: 100 times/day. Screen wake OFF for notifications; 150 message push notifications/day. Screen operations: 5 mins/day. Incoming call reminders: 3 times/day.
Heavy usage scenario: 24-hour wear / Heart rate constantly on (every 1 min) / Sleep monitoring (Assisted sleep monitoring enabled) / Stress monitoring enabled / Sleep breathing quality monitoring enabled (8 hours/day). Bluetooth calling: 30 mins/week. Music playback via Bluetooth headphones: 60 mins/week. 3 workouts per week, 30 minutes each with watch-side GPS running. Raise-to-wake: 200 times/day. Screen wake ON for notifications; 150 message push notifications/day. Screen operations: 15 mins/day. Incoming call reminders: 3 times/day.
AOD Mode scenario: AOD standby: 10 hours/day. 24-hour wear / Heart rate constantly on (every 1 min) / Sleep monitoring (Assisted sleep monitoring enabled) / Stress monitoring enabled / Sleep breathing quality monitoring enabled (8 hours/day). Bluetooth calling: 30 mins/week. Music playback via Bluetooth headphones: 60 mins/week. 3 workouts per week, 30 minutes each with watch-side GPS running. Raise-to-wake: 200 times/day. Screen wake ON for notifications; 150 message push notifications/day. Screen operations: 15 mins/day. Incoming call reminders: 3 times/day.
GPS Continuous Use Time: Continuous GPS activity, heart rate always on, including watch trajectory recording.

2. Podcast support will be added via software update.

3. The Amazfit Bip Max can be used as a map browsing tool to import OSM map files. The downloaded offline map must match your real location to be displayed, and a route file must be imported for navigation – it's not possible to choose a point on the offline map for navigation. The shown straight line back to the start of a journey may not be a practical route to follow due to environmental factors; this is only intended to help you keep track of your position in relation to the start point of the journey. Navigation functions are only compatible with outdoor sports modes.

4. Indoor positioning services are not supported. Positioning speed and accuracy may be affected by the surrounding environment. The number of satellites connected to simultaneously, and specific satellite connections, may depend on your location.

5. VO₂ Max is only supported within Outdoor Running, Trail Running, and Track Run modes.

6. This product and the Zepp App are not medical devices and cannot be used for medical purposes, or as basis for diagnosis of any medical condition. Detection results are provided for reference only. Please consult professional medical institutions if you feel unwell. 24-hour monitoring of heart rate and blood-oxygen saturation (SpO₂) need to be enabled in the Zepp App. For heart rate monitoring, the user must enable Auto Heart Rate Monitor in the Zepp App, and the minimum value can be set to continuous (second-level heart rate). Abnormal heart rate alerts and the preset value need to be set in the Zepp App. To measure blood-oxygen saturation (SpO₂), please wear the watch tightly at one finger-width from the wrist, and keep your arm still for best results. SpO₂ alerts are sent if the detected rate is too low compared to the preset value, which needs to be set in the Zepp App, at a minimum of 80%. Movement, and environmental and physical characteristics can affect speed and accuracy of monitoring and measurement. The 24-hour stress level monitoring needs to be enabled on the watch or in the Zepp App. Alerts for high stress levels are based on the preset value, and prompts for the breathing exercise need to be enabled on the watch. Smart health alerts need to be enabled in the watch settings or Zepp App. To process the one-tap measurement and other manual metric measurements, please wear the watch tightly at one finger-width from the wrist, and keep your arm still for best results. Movement, and environmental and physical characteristics can affect speed and accuracy of monitoring and measurement. Sleep monitoring can record night sleep and naps that last more than 20 minutes. Sleep Breathing Quality tracking needs to be enabled in the Zepp App or in the settings of the watch's Sleep feature.

7. Zepp Flow™ currently supports these languages: English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Brazilian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Polish.

8. WhatsApp speech-to-text replies, and receiving of picture messages from instant messaging platforms, require connection to an Android phone with Android 7 or above.

9. The material used for the packaging box is 100% recyclable, with naturally degradable materials including mineral-free inks and anodized aluminum used in the bronzing process.

10. According to the ISO 22810:2010 standard, the Amazfit Bip Max achieves a rating of 5 ATM, for a water-resistance of up to 50 meters, and is therefore suitable for splashes, snow, showering, or swimming. It has passed third-party testing conducted by SGS, and the report number is SHES260300518171. Remove the watch when taking a hot shower or trip to the sauna, since too much steam can affect the seal and make it less water-resistant in future. Do not wear the watch with a leather or metal strap when swimming - when preparing to swim, change to a silicone strap or other suitable type. For more information, please visit the support page at: support.amazfit.com

11. 3,000nit brightness is not supported if battery life is below 30%. Depending on your environment, the watch can reach up to 2,000nit brightness after automatic brightness has been enabled in the watch settings.

12. Smart recognition of strength training exercises can only be engaged within the Strength Training sports mode. 25 exercises are able to be recognized at time of product release, including: Bodyweight squats, Straight arm front squats, Barbell squats, Tricep pushdowns, Bent over rows, Barbell bench press, Sit-up holds, Knee-touch sit-ups, Dumbbell flys, Burpees, Burpee jumps, Overhead tricep extensions, Lying tricep extensions, Lateral raises, Jumping jacks, Lat pulldowns, Deadlift, Push-up, Shoulder press, Pull up, Biceps curl, Seated cable rows, Upright row, Straight-arm pulldowns, Russian twists. If an exercise is not auto-recognized by watch, the Zepp App can provide a list of muscle groups or exercise names to choose from.

13. Corresponding sports modes include: Outdoor Running, Treadmill, Walking, Indoor Walking, Outdoor Cycling, Pool Swimming, Rowing Machine, Elliptical. The accuracy and sensitivity of the workout recognition feature varies from person to person, and are related to the posture and proficiency of the user during their workout. Short workout duration or frequent changes in posture may not trigger the automatic recognition feature. When you are driving a car or taking a bus, or taking part in other such activities, accidental recognition may be triggered if these activities are particularly similar to the selected workout mode. When you are conducting outdoor activities, if the GPS signal is poor or the AGPS data information has not been synchronized with the mobile phone for an extended period, these outdoor activities may be assessed as indoor activities.

14. Training templates and interval training templates are compatible with: Strength training, Outdoor running, Treadmill, Outdoor cycling, Indoor cycling, Rope skipping, Rowing machine, Indoor fitness, Core training, and Stair climbing, Pool Swimming, Mountain Biking, BMX, HIIT, Cross Training, Race Walking, Track Running, Electric Bicycle, Electric Mountain Bike, Gravel Cycling, Road Cycling, Off-Road Cycling, HYROX Training.

15. Specific app availability may vary depending on your country or region. Apple Health is only available on iOS devices, and Google Fit is only available on Android devices.

16. Connection to peripheral Bluetooth devices only supports devices with BLE connection. Supported devices include: heart rate belts, power meters, cadence meters, cycling speedometers, and thermometers.

17. Live broadcast of sports data and turn-by-turn directions supports English and Chinese broadcasts; this must be enabled in the watch settings.

18. Alerts and reminders need to be enabled in the watch settings or Zepp App.

19. Due to the device's storage limit, only a maximum of 20 membership cards can be added to the same account. Supported codes include Code 128, Code 39, Code 25, PDF 417, Date Matrix, UPC A, EAN 13, and EAN 8 and QR codes.

20. Morning updates need to be set in the Zepp App or in the watch settings, and the currently supported content is: Zepp Coach, cycle tracking, weather, battery, sleep, schedule, PAI, yesterday's activity.

The product images and screen content shown above are for reference purpose only. The actual product (including but not limited to its appearance, color and size) and screen display content (including but not limited to the background, UI and graphics) may differ slightly.

The data that is provided on this page without a specified source is taken from internal laboratories or supplier data, and has been obtained under a specific test environment. The product's actual performance may differ slightly due to product individual differences, software versions, usage conditions and environmental factors.

To provide product information, specifications and characteristics as accurately as possible, our company may adjust and revise the text descriptions, images and other content in the above pages at any time. Due to real-time changes in product batches and production-supply factors, we may modify the above information as required without providing a special notice.

The radio waves generated by the equipment may affect the normal operation of implanted medical equipment or personal medical equipment, such as pacemakers and hearing aids. If you use these devices, please consult their manufacturers for restrictions on using this device.

The product should not be worn in environments with strong magnetic fields such as MRI machines or medical imaging machines, as they may cause damage to the watch.
